prompts.hirsutism: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE finished horizontal 16:9 editorial blog cover, full bleed, no text. Article subject: hirsutism in women, understanding the hormonal signals behind excess facial hair. Art direction: moody cinematic analog editorial photograph, sophisticated restrained atmosphere, deep forest teal shadows and narrow warm amber light, deliberate optical defocus and subtle directional motion blur, fine film grain, halation, rich blacks. Subject: close intimate cropped side profile of an adult woman with natural skin and a few subtle fine hairs catching the rim light along her lower cheek and jaw, hair tied back, clothed in a simple dark top. Respectful, calm, thoughtful, neither ashamed nor distressed. Compose a recognizable sculptural profile in the central-right portion, backed by soft translucent glass reflections and dark out of focus interior. Crop from temple to shoulder, face turned gently toward window light. Natural fine facial hair should be understated, not a beard or exaggerated medical symptom. A sliver of cheek and jaw sharp, remainder softly blurred; not glossy beauty advertising. Designed to remain recognizable when small and cropped centrally. The atmosphere of a serious cultural journal's cinematic cover, strongly contrasting a white website with burgundy typography. NO words, titles, typography, logos, watermark, diagram, pastel pink background, flat illustration, star motifs or website UI. Output one image only, landscape 16:9.
prompts.pcos: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished horizontal 16:9 full bleed editorial blog cover, no text. Article subject: PCOS, a hormonal and metabolic system whose interacting rhythms can fall out of sync. Make an original photographic conceptual still life: three beautiful translucent thick smoked-glass circular loops stand upright at subtly different tilts, overlapping in depth, one slightly offset breaking the rhythm. These are physical irregular glass loops photographed on a very dark surface, NOT a Venn diagram, not medical anatomy. Deep midnight petrol and charcoal shadows, pale cold cyan edge light, muted olive reflections with one subtle honey amber light leak at the bottom. Volumetric translucent material, broad blurred refractions, shallow depth of field, optical diffusion, a little long-exposure smearing in the background, fine analog grain and halation. Quiet, tactile, mysterious, premium art-directed culture magazine photograph, not futuristic shiny 3D interface art. Central sculpture fills about 65% of the frame, readable silhouette in a small thumbnail, generous dark breathing room, strong luminous-dark contrast with some details disappearing into shadow. Original thematic metaphor for connected rhythms, not a diagnostic visualization. No women, ovaries, flowers, text, titles, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, labels, diagram lines, pastel pink, stars, icons, website UI. One landscape image only, aspect ratio 16:9.
prompts.testosterone: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE finished horizontal 16:9 full bleed editorial blog cover, no text. Article subject: interpreting a woman's high testosterone lab result in context rather than an isolated number. Original moody conceptual laboratory still-life photographed like a cinematic editorial image. Two clear unlabelled slim laboratory sample tubes stand in a tiny dark brushed-metal holder, in front of a large thick textured optical glass slab. One narrow amber line of light passes through the glass and splits into layered warm blurred reflections, a visual metaphor for interpreting a signal. No bodily fluids visible. A pale unmarked sheet sits partly visible on the table in foreground, heavily out of focus, no readable writing or numbers. The sample tubes and optical slab make one compelling central composition, no clutter. Deep aubergine-black and ink-blue shadows, burnt amber highlights and a faint muted cyan reflection, a restrained connection to a burgundy brand without copying its pink design. Dramatic chiaroscuro, deliberate shallow focus, lens diffusion, soft motion smearing at frame edges, analog film grain and glowing halation. Material realism, sophisticated serious journal aesthetic, no stock medical advertisement and no glowing sci-fi molecules. Clear silhouette readable in small thumbnail, safe for center crop. No text, typography, charts, labels, logos, watermark, medical cross, hands, needles, people, flat illustration, pink background, decorative star, UI. Output one landscape 16:9 image only.
